categories.main_business_segments: Robert Half Inc. operates three primary business segments: contract talent solutions, permanent placement talent solutions, and Protiviti. Contract talent solutions provides temporary engagement professionals in finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support roles. Permanent placement talent solutions focuses on full-time employee placements in similar functional areas. Protiviti is a global consulting firm offering internal audit, risk, business, technology, and governance consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to match candidates to job opportunities and assist with lead generation and candidate assessment. The company employs cloud-based systems and digital platforms for candidate and client management. Protiviti uses industry-standard consulting methodologies and frameworks for delivering business and technology consulting services, with expanding focus on AI-enabled solutions including responsible AI governance and risk assessment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse client base across multiple industries including finance, technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and government sectors. Primary customers range from small businesses to Fortune 500 companies and government entities. The company places approximately 125,000 engagement professionals annually and serves clients across North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia, with 77.5% of revenues from U.S. operations and 22.5% from international operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates through 313 offices in 42 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and 18 foreign countries for talent solutions. Protiviti operates 65 offices in 23 U.S. states and 13 foreign countries. Key international markets include Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Brazil, France, Germany, and other European nations. Headquarters are located in Menlo Park and San Ramon, California.
categories.supply_chain_position: Robert Half operates as a midstream service provider in the talent and consulting supply chain. The company acts as an intermediary between job seekers and employers, employing temporary professionals and placing them with client companies. For permanent placements, the company identifies and matches candidates with employers. Protiviti operates as a professional services provider offering consulting and advisory services directly to enterprise clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company is investing heavily in technology and artificial intelligence, including proprietary AI engines for candidate-to-job matching and lead generation. Strategic priorities include enhancing digital experiences for clients and candidates, leveraging proprietary data assets to improve AI tools for recruiters, and expanding Protiviti's AI-enabled consulting offerings with focus on responsible AI governance. The company is also evaluating generative AI applications to enhance business operations and service delivery.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenues through three primary models: (1) contract talent solutions—clients pay hourly rates for temporary engagement professionals employed by Robert Half; (2) permanent placement talent solutions—employers pay placement fees calculated as a percentage of the new employee's annual compensation; (3) Protiviti consulting—revenues from time-and-material and fixed-fee consulting engagements. In 2023, service revenues totaled $6.39 billion, with contract talent solutions representing 61%, permanent placement 9%, and Protiviti 30% of total revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In talent solutions, the company competes with numerous national, regional, and local staffing firms, with local companies often being the strongest competitors. The company differentiates through its global brand, extensive office network, global candidate database, and advanced AI-driven technologies, which provide competitive advantages in out-of-market recruitment. For Protiviti, primary competitors are the Big Four accounting firms and other large consulting firms. Protiviti differentiates through collaborative client approaches, knowledge transfer, and blended resourcing models combining full-time consultants with specialized talent from Robert Half's network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Robert Half is a large-cap public company with approximately $6.39 billion in annual service revenues as of 2023, representing an 11.7% decline from 2022 due to macroeconomic uncertainty. The company reported net income of $411 million in 2023, down 37.5% from $658 million in 2022. The company has approximately 15,000 full-time internal staff and places approximately 125,000 engagement professionals annually. The company maintains strong liquidity with $732 million in cash and generates substantial operating cash flow of $637 million in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Robert Half differentiates through its industry-leading brand recognition, specialized expertise in professional staffing across multiple functional areas, and advanced AI-powered matching technology. The company offers clients cost control through variable staffing solutions and provides candidates access to diverse employment opportunities. Protiviti differentiates through its collaborative consulting approach, deep expertise in governance and risk management, and ability to blend full-time consultants with specialized talent resources. The company emphasizes reliability, quality service, and the ability to quickly provide skilled professionals, supported by proprietary data assets and technology infrastructure.
